summary:
The meeting addressed critical strategic initiatives for The Derma Co's sunscreen portfolio, focusing on both the expansion of an existing high-demand product and the introduction of an innovative new formulation. Discussions highlighted significant growth opportunities within the quick commerce segment and strategies to enhance market penetration and profitability.

For the existing 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen, a substantial 40% month-on-month surge in demand was reported across quick commerce platforms like Blinkit and Zepto. Consumer feedback from South India indicated a strong preference for larger pack sizes, with users frequently purchasing multiple 50g units. The R&D team confirmed the readiness of an 80g pump format, having successfully completed all stability, SPF 50+ in-vivo verification, and CTRI registration, demonstrating robust performance even at elevated temperatures.

The second key agenda item was the new tinted matte gel sunscreen prototype. Internal dermatologist panel feedback was overwhelmingly positive, with 88% praising its zero-white-cast finish on FitzPatrick skin types IV and V. This breakthrough presents a significant opportunity to reduce customer acquisition costs on Meta, potentially dropping blended CAC below ₹180 by positioning it as an all-in-one daily primer and broad-spectrum protector.

Strategic considerations for the new tinted sunscreen included maintaining a strict fragrance-free claim, which is crucial for Derma Co loyalists with sensitive skin, and ensuring a competitive price point under ₹599 to drive volume velocity against international competitors. The meeting concluded with clear directives for product launch acceleration and strategic marketing alignment.
keyTopics: Expansion of The Derma Co's 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel Sunscreen with a new 80g SKU to meet surging quick commerce demand.
Strategic development and market positioning of a new Tinted Matte Gel Sunscreen, leveraging positive dermatologist feedback and potential for reduced customer acquisition costs.
decisions: Approved the fast-tracking of the 80g SKU launch for the 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen to address consumer demand for larger pack sizes.
Agreed to proceed with the development and launch of the tinted matte gel sunscreen, with a mandate to maintain a strict fragrance-free claim and ensure a competitive price point under ₹599.

actionItems.task: Ensure 3 weeks of safety stock for the 80g 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel variant in the Bhiwandi and Nelamangala mother hubs.
Develop a comprehensive positioning strategy for the new tinted matte gel sunscreen as an all-in-one daily primer plus broad-spectrum protection.
Confirm and maintain the strict fragrance-free claim for the tinted matte gel sunscreen formulation throughout product development and marketing.
Finalize the pricing strategy for the tinted matte gel sunscreen to ensure it remains under ₹599.
actionItems.deadline: Prior to tinted matte gel sunscreen launch

[Varun Alagh]: Welcome everyone. Let's look at the quarterly performance for The Derma Co sunscreen range, specifically our 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel. As you know, consumer demand on Blinkit and Zepto has surged 40% month-on-month.
[Ghazal Alagh]: Yes, but our customer care team is noticing in the recent KYC calls that users in South India want larger pack sizes. They are currently buying two 50g packs a month. We need to fast-track the 80g SKU launch.
[Head of R&D]: The stability and SPF 50+ in-vivo verification for the 80g pump format is already complete with CTRI registration. The viscosity and preservative efficacy tests show zero degradation even at 45 degrees Celsius.
[Quick Commerce Lead]: From the supply chain side, our dark store fill rate in Bangalore and Hyderabad is at 94%. If we launch the 80g variant, we need at least 3 weeks of safety stock in the Bhiwandi and Nelamangala mother hubs.
[Meeting Note Added]: Initial discussion on sunscreen quick commerce turnaround

--- [Segment 2 | 10:00 - 20:00] ---

[Head of R&D]: Moving to the next formulation agenda: the tinted matte gel sunscreen prototype. In our internal panel of 45 dermatologists, 88% praised the zero-white-cast finish on FitzPatrick skin types IV and V.
[Performance Marketing]: That's huge because our customer acquisition cost (CAC) on Meta for sunscreen is currently around ₹240. If we position this as an all-in-one daily primer plus broad-spectrum protection, our blended CAC could drop below ₹180.
[Ghazal Alagh]: Agreed, but ensure the fragrance-free claim remains strict. Our consumer surveys repeatedly prove that Derma Co loyalists choose us specifically because our actives are gentle on sensitive, acne-prone barriers.
[Varun Alagh]: Let's ensure the price point stays under ₹599 to maintain volume velocity against international competitors.
[Meeting Note Added]: Reviewing dermatological clinical trial results
summary:
The meeting focused on two critical strategic pillars for The Derma Co: optimizing the performance of the existing 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen range and strategizing the launch of a new tinted matte gel sunscreen. Discussions highlighted significant consumer demand and operational readiness for product enhancements and new introductions.

Regarding the 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen, a remarkable 40% month-on-month surge in demand was noted on quick commerce platforms. A key consumer insight from South India indicated a strong preference for larger pack sizes, leading to a strategic decision to fast-track the launch of an 80g SKU. R&D confirmed the 80g pump format's stability and SPF 50+ efficacy, with supply chain readiness requiring a three-week safety stock in key mother hubs.

The second agenda item centered on the new tinted matte gel sunscreen prototype. Internal dermatologist panels provided overwhelmingly positive feedback, with 88% praising its zero-white-cast finish on diverse skin types. This breakthrough presents a significant opportunity to reduce customer acquisition costs by positioning it as an all-in-one daily primer and broad-spectrum protector. Strategic alignment was reached on maintaining a strict fragrance-free claim, aligning with Derma Co's brand promise for sensitive skin, and ensuring a competitive price point under ₹599 to drive volume velocity.

Overall, the meeting established clear directives for product development, supply chain optimization, and marketing strategy, aiming to capitalize on existing market demand and successfully introduce innovative new products.

80g SKU Launch Readiness: Review of R&D's completion of stability, SPF 50+ in-vivo verification, and CTRI registration for the 80g pump format, alongside supply chain requirements for safety stock in Bhiwandi and Nelamangala.

Tinted Matte Gel Sunscreen Prototype & Market Strategy: Presentation of positive dermatologist feedback (88% approval for zero-white-cast), potential for reduced customer acquisition costs through strategic positioning, and critical considerations for fragrance-free claims and competitive pricing under ₹599.

Position the new tinted matte gel sunscreen as an all-in-one daily primer plus broad-spectrum protection.
Maintain a strict fragrance-free claim for the tinted matte gel sunscreen to align with brand loyalist expectations.
Price the tinted matte gel sunscreen under ₹599 to ensure volume velocity against international competitors.

actionItems.task: Ensure 3 weeks of safety stock for the 80g 1% Hyaluronic Aqua Gel sunscreen variant in Bhiwandi and Nelamangala mother hubs.
Develop and execute performance marketing strategy to position the tinted matte gel sunscreen as an all-in-one daily primer plus broad-spectrum protection.
Ensure the final formulation and marketing communication for the tinted matte gel sunscreen strictly adheres to the fragrance-free claim.
Finalize the pricing strategy for the tinted matte gel sunscreen to ensure it remains under ₹599.
